# API Contract & Authorization Checklist: Wallets & Membership

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements behind the B4 API surface frozen for the C4 client, and the permission matrix every later spec depends on.
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [wallets.yaml](../../../docs/openapi/paths/wallets.yaml)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all response members of the Wallet record enumerated with their type and nullability? [Completeness, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK002 Are all response members of the Wallet Member record enumerated, including how the member's identity is named without colliding with the user-scope key? [Completeness, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK003 Does every operation list every error code it can return, including the verification-gate and entitlement refusals? [Completeness, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK004 Is the outcome defined for a whole-wallet save carrying a version above zero for an identifier that does not exist? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK005 Is the outcome (code and pointer) defined for a partial save carrying only the version and no editable member? [Gap, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK006 Is the outcome defined when the version is missing from a delete, archive or transfer body? [Gap, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK007 Is the field-level code for a blank or over-long wallet name specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK008 Does the spec state which changes move a wallet's `change_seq` without moving its `version`, so the client does not read it as an edit? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is "identical write" defined precisely enough to decide replay versus conflict, including for a create replayed with version 0? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK010 Is the ordering by `name` specified (collation / case), or explicitly declared non-locale-aware? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011a]
- [x] CHK011 Is "currency locked" defined by an observable condition the client can mirror? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK012 Is the sign convention for liability opening balances stated unambiguously on the wire? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK013 Is the transfer-target refusal's code and pointer specified, and is reusing an existing code justified? [Clarity, Spec §5]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK014 Is the refusal precedence in §6 consistent with the per-operation outcomes in the OpenAPI descriptions? [Consistency, Spec §6]
- [x] CHK015 Is tombstone visibility consistent across FR-011, the edge cases, US2 scenario 8 and the precedence list? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK016 Are the events in §7 consistent with the constitution's Publishes column, and is the needed amendment named? [Consistency, Spec §7]
- [x] CHK017 Is the audit writer for membership events consistent between the spec and the security baseline, with the baseline change named? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK018 Are the versioning semantics consistent with the existing `saveProfile` contract the client already implements? [Consistency, Spec §5]

## Authorization Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Does every matrix row state the outcome for owner, editor, viewer and non-member? [Coverage, Spec §6]
- [x] CHK020 Is every capability-gated row tied to a named Feature resolved through the wallet owner? [Coverage, Spec §6]
- [x] CHK021 Is it defined whether pending invitations count toward the members-per-wallet quota in row S-02, or is that explicitly deferred? [Gap, Spec §6]
- [x] CHK022 Is the matrix's treatment of user-scoped resources (categories, budgets) explicit, so no later spec grants per-wallet category rights? [Coverage, Spec §6]
- [x] CHK023 Is the two-wallet transfer case (T-03) specified so a write to a viewer-only wallet is denied as a whole? [Coverage, Spec §6]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK024 Are retry-safety requirements defined for every non-PUT write (archive, delete, transfer)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK025 Are concurrent-write requirements defined for two devices editing the same wallet? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK026 Is the deletion cascade defined for records owned by other modules (invitations) within the same unit of work? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, §7]
- [x] CHK027 Is the behaviour of ownership transfer before sharing exists (only one member) stated, so the client knows it can only be refused? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions]

## Non-Functional & Dependencies

- [x] CHK028 Is the list-read performance target quantified with a wallet count? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK029 Is the absence of rate limiting a recorded decision rather than an omission? [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK030 Are the provisional dependencies on B6 (postings), B9 (members) and B14 (feed) stated with what each stands in for? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Evaluated on 2026-10-02 by the design agent at the coordinator's request (owner away, delegated authority). Items found failing were fixed in spec.md in the same pass; see "Resolution log" below. Items are marked `[x]` only after the fix.

### Resolution log

| Item | Finding | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| CHK004 | Undefined | FR-008b: version > 0 for an unknown id → `404 NOT_FOUND` |
| CHK005 | Undefined | §5: version-only PATCH → `422`, `REQUIRED` at pointer `""` (the body root) |
| CHK006 | Undefined | §5: missing version → `422`, `REQUIRED` at `/version` |
| CHK007 | Undefined | FR-003: blank or > 100 → `OUT_OF_RANGE` at `/name` |
| CHK008 | Only in OpenAPI | FR-012: `change_seq` moves on any write in the wallet; `version` only on the wallet's own changes |
| CHK010 | Ambiguous | FR-011a: byte-order (`C` collation), not locale-aware; clients re-sort for display |
| CHK021 | Undefined | §9 open question 5, deferred to B9 |
